title: 第19章 命中注定再死一次第20章 人生要有格调
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 铜镜缓缓转动，镜子里定格在王易死亡的那一刻。
他被血光剥肉抽筋，空余白骨，画面中的另一位少女还没受伤。
【凶手尚未露面，用一口四足红鼎，取走了全身的精气和血肉。】
王易死在红鼎下，凶手便是那尊神秘的婴仙。
可是，这面铜镜真有如此逆天的威力，连传说中的婴仙都能算计在内吗？
王易瞳孔闪烁不定，沉默的等待着。
【假若，我也有一件这样的法宝，一件逆天改命，夺天地造化的法宝，那么结局是不是会有所不同？】
镜面又一次翻转，乌云上掉下一口红色小鼎，沉在了王易的丹田深处。
【冤有头，债有主】
【世道险恶，人心难测，我不杀人人杀我】
【婴仙又如何？】
【前世遗泽：婴灵仙宝，血海肉山三世红鼎】
“你知道吗，三小姐回来了。”
耳边又响起了这句话，王易睁开眼睛，陷入沉默。
廋厨子还在炖汤煮肉，厨房里挤满了燥热的气息。
王易慢慢转过头，瞧了眼窗外的天色，心中忽然有了个大胆的想法。
他想跑，现在就跑，逃离柳州城，再也不回头。
“有什么理由不跑呢？”
“我身具灵根，还有一品功法，现在连法宝都不缺了，何必跟陈清月去太一宗自寻死路？”
成年人说的客道话听听就好，他们说的再见很可能是再也不见。
王易并非心血来潮，而是经过深思熟虑后做出的选择。
他一跃而起，先一脚踢开碍眼的周浩，再一脚踹开了厨房的大门。
“哐当~”
王易说走就走，毫不留恋。
他风风火火的跑了出去，只留下满脸懵逼的廋厨子。
“去哪儿啊！？”
“还回来吃饭吗！？”
王易充耳不闻，置之不理。
一个奴隶翻墙越院，离开陈家府邸，穿过几条街道，逃离了柳州城。
夜幕晴朗，林风清凉，王易离开古城，钻进了一片郁郁葱葱的森林里。
他闷头赶了一夜路，不管身体疲惫，不顾林中野兽低吼，直到第二天蒙蒙亮，王易才发现自己已经穿过了森林，来到了另一边。
脚下是一片青草，对面是微风阵阵、草絮纷飞的旷野。
王易扶着树干，走出林荫，深深的吸了口气。
content_en:
The bronze mirror rotated slowly, and the moment of Wang Yi's death was frozen in the mirror.
His flesh was stripped of blood and cramped, leaving only bones. The other girl in the picture was not injured.
[The murderer has not yet shown up, using a four-legged red cauldron to take away the essence, flesh and blood from the whole body. 】
Wang Yi died under the red tripod, and the murderer was the mysterious infant fairy.
However, this bronze mirror really has such heaven-defying power that it can even count on the legendary infant fairy?
Wang Yi's pupils flickered and he waited silently.
【……】
[If I had such a magic weapon, a magic weapon that could defy heaven and change fate, and seize the fortune of heaven and earth, would the outcome be different? 】
The mirror flipped over again, and a small red cauldron fell from the dark clouds and sank deep into Wang Yi's Dantian.
[Every injustice has its owner, every debt has its owner]
[The world is dangerous and people’s hearts are unpredictable. If I don’t kill anyone, everyone will kill me.]
[What about the infant fairy? 】
[Legacy of the past life: Infant Spirit Immortal Treasure, Sea of Blood and Roshan III Red Cauldron]
…
"You know, the third lady is back."
With these words ringing in his ears again, Wang Yi opened his eyes and fell into silence.
The lean cook was still simmering soup and cooking meat, and the kitchen was filled with hot smells.
Wang Yi slowly turned his head, looked at the sky outside the window, and suddenly had a bold idea in his mind.
He wanted to run, run now, escape from Liuzhou City and never look back.
"What's the reason not to run?"
"I have spiritual roots and first-level skills. Now I don't even lack magic weapons. Why should I go to Taiyi Sect with Chen Qingyue to seek death?"
Just listen to the polite words adults say, and the goodbyes they say may very well mean we'll never see you again.
Wang Yi did not make a choice on a whim, but after careful consideration.
He jumped up, first kicked Zhou Hao away, who was an eyesore, and then kicked open the kitchen door.
"Clang~"
Wang Yi left as soon as he said it, without any hesitation.
He ran out in a hurry, leaving only the confused cook behind.
"Where are you going!?"
"Are you coming back for dinner!?"
Wang Yi turned a deaf ear and ignored him.
A slave climbed over the wall, crossed the courtyard, left the Chen family's mansion, walked through several streets, and fled Liuzhou City.
The night was clear and the forest breeze was cool. Wang Yi left the ancient city and entered a lush forest.
He drove all night, regardless of his physical fatigue and the roar of wild beasts in the forest. It was not until dawn the next day that Wang Yi realized that he had passed through the forest and arrived on the other side.
There is a piece of green grass under your feet, and across the way is a wilderness with gentle breeze and flying grass.
Wang Yi held on to the tree trunk, walked out of the shade, and took a deep breath.
title_en: Chapter 19 Destined to die again Chapter 20 Life must be in style
